overview_description.description:
We provide solutions for children needing proper and quality education, access to lab
facilities, and qualified tutors. Through our technology, we can solve these issues. We
are developing metaverse classrooms, conference halls, and concert halls and providing virtual labs and experiments. In addition, we have AI companions throughout
your metaverse space. These AI companions can act as guides and assistants. Users can have
conversations with the AI and store these interactions. If users attend a seminar or session, the
AI can record the entire session.
Interesting Part:
● Stored AI data can be transferred to anyone through NFTs.
● For example, if users are taking a professional course, they can use AI as an assistant.
At the end of the course, the AI will have stored data, which can be given to someone
else or sold. This action will be processed through NFTs
